name.zh: 网格世界 · Q 学习

desc.zh: 表格 Q-learning：ε 从 0.5 衰减到 0.05，策略箭头从随机乱指收敛成直达终点的路线；奖励格每 episode 只结算一次，可在表单里改障碍后重训
desc.en: Tabular Q-learning: epsilon decays from 0.5 to 0.05 while the policy arrows converge from random to a route straight to the goal. Each reward cell pays out once per episode; edit the obstacles in the form and retrain
